filings.description: LD-1 registrations and LD-2 quarterly activity reports: one row per filing (registrant, client, income or expenses, period, posted date; activities as JSON).

filing_period.desc: first_quarter | second_quarter | third_quarter | fourth_quarter | mid_year | year_end (older semiannual reports)

filing_type.desc: code, e.g. Q1, 1A (Q1 amendment), RR (registration); endpoint filing_types lists all

registrant_name.desc: lobbying firm or self-filing organization (substring match)

client_name.desc: client (who the lobbying is for; substring match)

client_country.desc: client country code, e.g. US, CN

lobbyist_covered_position.desc: former covered government position text, e.g. Chief of Staff

filing_specific_lobbying_issues.desc: words in the specific-issues text, e.g. semiconductor or H.R. 4763

client_ppb_state.desc: client principal place of business state

lobbyist_conviction_disclosure_indicator.desc: true = a listed lobbyist disclosed a conviction

foreign_entity_listed_indicator.desc: true = the filing lists a foreign entity

filing_activities.description: The same filings, one row per lobbying activity (issue code, specific issues text, lobbyists, government entities contacted). Optional issue_code filters client-side (the API has no issue filter).

filing_period.desc: first_quarter | second_quarter | third_quarter | fourth_quarter | mid_year | year_end (older semiannual reports)

filing_type.desc: code, e.g. Q1, 1A (Q1 amendment), RR (registration); endpoint filing_types lists all

registrant_name.desc: lobbying firm or self-filing organization (substring match)

client_name.desc: client (who the lobbying is for; substring match)

client_country.desc: client country code, e.g. US, CN

lobbyist_covered_position.desc: former covered government position text, e.g. Chief of Staff

filing_specific_lobbying_issues.desc: words in the specific-issues text, e.g. semiconductor or H.R. 4763

issue_code.desc: general issue code kept after download, e.g. TAX, HCR, TRD (filter applied by the pack)

client_ppb_state.desc: client principal place of business state

lobbyist_conviction_disclosure_indicator.desc: true = a listed lobbyist disclosed a conviction

foreign_entity_listed_indicator.desc: true = the filing lists a foreign entity

contributions.description: LD-203 contribution reports (semiannual): one row per contribution item (contributor, payee, honoree, amount, date); reports with no contributions give one row with no_contributions=True.

contribution_payee.desc: payee name, e.g. a campaign committee

contribution_honoree.desc: honoree name, e.g. a member of Congress

contribution_type.desc: feca | he (honorary expense) | me (meeting expense) | ple (presidential library) | pic (inaugural committee)

id.desc: registrant id (registrant_id is accepted and sent as id)

clients.description: Clients (organizations on whose behalf lobbying is done).

id.desc: client id (client_id is accepted and sent as id)

client_state.desc: two-letter (state is accepted and sent as client_state)

filing_types.description: Filing type codes (value, name), amendments and terminations included.

government_entities.description: Government entities that can be listed as contacted.
